engaged head-on, because this change ADDS a token census. parsePublishedManifest (recovery.mjs:238-271, twin mitosis.js:577-610) classifies a payload and must halt on the unclassifiable rather than sanitise it. The OTHER closed census in this repo, MIRROR_CENSUS, is deliberately NOT extended: both new code homes are existing WHOLE-census modules, so no new lib module exists to classify and mirror-guard's readdir-based halt is not engaged || FIX ROUND: STRENGTHENED, and structurally rather than by adding a case. parsePublishedManifest is the closed census; before this round it ran on the READ side only, so the WRITE side had no classifier at all and could push a payload the census permanently rejects onto a write-once ref that no code path can repair. mitosis.js:4282 now runs that same census over the composed payload before any push, and :4309-4310 re-runs it over the read-back and canonicalises through buildPublishedManifest, making the publish verification content-exact instead of byte-exact - strictly stricter on content, lenient only on formatting. One census, both sides. The new 4-way absence taxonomy (recovery.mjs:283-291) is not a catch-all: its final branch is the DEFINITE-absence case, the undetermined case is classified explicitly as probeFailed, and the engine HALTS on it at mitosis.js:4048-4050 rather than folding an unanswered read into absence. || ROUND 3: strengthened on two gates and no census was weakened. parsePublishedManifest gains one closed clause - isRepoRelativePath rejects a leading /, any .. segment, a Windows drive prefix and a backslash (recovery.mjs:206-211, twin mitosis.js:553-558) - so an absolute or escaping spec path halts the read rather than being sanitised. publishedManifestRef gains a closed /^[a-f0-9]{64}$/ guard on specContentHash that THROWS rather than composing a ref from an unclassifiable token (checkpoint.mjs:52-57, twin mitosis.js:2928-2933), mirroring the existing RUN_ID_PATTERN guard. The probe-agreement check (mitosis.js:4064-4070) is likewise closed: the engine re-derives the ref and any character difference, or a null probe where a hash exists, classifies as UNDETERMINED rather than as absence. identityPayloadRefusalCause is diagnostic only - it never gates the push; parsePublishedManifest alone decides, and it has a final catch-all string for a rejection it cannot attribute, which is honest rather than a pinned count. Candidly: the backslash clause is one rule BEYOND the three the change ratified (leading /, .. segment, Windows drive); it was added because a UNC \\server\share path passes all three and still leaks a machine path, and it is recorded here rather than folded in silently.
